title: Apex Mythic Beast & Dragon
body: Bestiary profile for dragons, leviathans, and apex predators including anatomy, breath/magic traits, lair ecology, and weaknesses.

sampleValues.Size & Silhouette: 65-foot serpentine sea-dragon with translucent sail-fins and bioluminescent cheek plates
sampleValues.Armor, Scales & Sensory Organs: Hexagonal silica scales refract sunlight underwater, rendering it nearly invisible until it strikes.
sampleValues.Preferred Biome & Lair Style: Sunken volcanic vents and drowned shipwrecks along continental shelves.
sampleValues.Diet, Life Cycle & Hoard Behavior: Feeds on giant squid and ironclad hulls; nests inside copper-rich wrecks to strengthen newborn scale plating.
sampleValues.Breath Weapon or Signature Power: Expels superheated steam-jets that boil sea-water into blinding scalding fog.
sampleValues.Fatal Weaknesses & Hunter Tactics: Acoustic bells shatter its inner ear equilibrium; vulnerable beneath the throat-gill hinge when inhaling.
